protocol: Predictions recorded before any hook-ablation code executes. Results must be compared against these expectations; agreement and disagreement are both reportable.

mechanism.name: completion_guard_hook
mechanism.description: Deterministic completion guard at the stop boundary. Checks that acceptance criteria, targeted-test results, and QA evidence exist; if missing, blocks completion once and routes caught broken checks through one bounded repair pass using the existing fix_success_prob. Blind to semantic misreads that leave checks green.
mechanism.enters_formula_as: recovery factor in R(t); does not alter D(t) directly

predictions.rationale: Phase-B ceiling effect: full pipeline saturates final validity, leaving little residual breakage for a terminal guard to catch.
High stratum has more residual failure than medium under full pipeline, so a small positive delta is possible but still limited by upstream recovery.
A single fix iteration leaves more broken checks at stop time; the hook's one extra repair pass should raise final validity.
Highest residual terminal breakage among the three arms; largest expected absolute gain from the completion guard.
Without agentic QA, the fix loop never runs; the hook is the only terminal recovery and should produce a clear positive delta.
No QA recovery plus high decay pressure maximizes the number of broken checks at stop; the hook should show its largest effect here across the detect-prob sweep.

claim_rule: Cite measured deltas from data/hooks_ablation.json only. If a measured delta is negligible or negative, report that result and do not claim improvement for that cell.
